scope: Synthetic isolated receiver; presentation and navigation only; no stack availability claim

fixture_scope.no_sli: Unavailable observation fixture; does not calculate an SLI

typography_scope: CSS text sizes doubled individually and WCAG text-spacing values via self-hosted fixture stylesheets. Not native browser zoom or a screen-reader test.
